scope: Preview-only authenticated release identity gate and source-equivalence correction. No paid execution, grants, customer records or Production changes.
riskAnalysis: Exact source equality conflated documentation checkpoints with application deployment. Only ancestor plus strict documentary paths may differ; application, dependency, workflow and unknown paths still require exact source. Fingerprint alone cannot establish website equivalence.

threatModel.assets: QA credentials, immutable deployment identity, feature alias, source history, authoritative release fingerprint, Production isolation.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Git checkout to authenticated branch identity; immutable endpoint to platform deployment metadata; QA CI secret to fixed trusted Preview origins.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale application mistaken for docs; sibling source; foreign deployment ID/project/branch; stale contracts; credential-bearing redirect; misleading current-success reports.
threatModel.mitigations: Strict ancestry and changed-path proof, immutable pair equality, expected fingerprint/project/branch, redirect error and bounded timeout; sanitized attempt reasons; independent platform readback and restricted feature-only alias assignment.

rollback: Keep paid disabled. Restore only recorded feature Preview alias to its prior verified READY disabled deployment if identity or QA fails; no Production promotion. Preserve failed runs and original records.

defects.rootCause: Browser gate required deployment SHA equal documentation checkpoint SHA while branch alias remained at earlier equivalent application deployment.
defects.detectionGap: No explicit documentation-versus-application equivalence or deployment ID/fingerprint binding in the old gate; failed identity values were not retained.
defects.regression: Actual gate accepts strict documentation ancestor equivalence and rejects runtime/config/workflow changes, unrelated history, deployment mismatches and stale fingerprint.
defects.historicalPrevention: Historical f95/6f documentation difference is recognized explicitly; new app changes still fail before browser testing; sanitized failed reason retained.

proactiveReview.architecture: QA alias bootstrap pins immutable Preview deployment; existing server QA guards unchanged; no operational ledger or model path.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Git history, Vercel system deployment identity and protected Preview, same current Redis/account auth; GitHub CI.
proactiveReview.threats: Stale application mistaken for docs; sibling source; foreign deployment ID/project/branch; stale contracts; credential-bearing redirect; misleading current-success reports.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Stale alias, missing system identity, source drift, unavailable endpoint, redirect, deployment replacement and documentation-only commit.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Executed request-faithful alias/immutable responses with identity and source mutation plus actual guarded identity function regression.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate QA and Engineering Auditor inspect actual code and downloaded hosted report.
proactiveReview.recovery: Keep paid disabled. Restore only recorded feature Preview alias to its prior verified READY disabled deployment if identity or QA fails; no Production promotion. Preserve failed runs and original records.
proactiveReview.readiness: Offline tests separate from exact-source hosted browser artifact; no paid workflow accuracy claims.
